description: Inside a nested parse over a captured span, onward and following-tokens end where that span ends, not where the stage's input ends (engine §4, §10).
grammar:
%rule text ($w:word C) %conditions $w.matches(probe)
%rule word (A B)
%rule probe ($a:A B) %conditions $a.following-tokens.matches(justb)
%rule justb B
